comment: Prof. Fulcher is such an amazing teacher! She really cares about her students. We were graded on two tests, one monologue and a scene with a partner (which was our final). She assigned short readings before each class, and one assignment every week, but they were both really easy to do. She's the best for any beginner in the acting field!

I took this for my gen-ed, and am very happy I did. Each week, you prepare an exercise to present along with the two main grades being a monologue and a partner scene. If you're shy, maybe this isn't the class for you, but otherwise you should definitely consider taking it with Fulcher. She is friendly, understanding, and an easy grader.

Super easy class for arts credit. Definitely have to go outside your comfort zone so recommend taking this class with friends. Not much work, have to memorize monologue and a scene for midterm and final but not as bad as you think. Worst part is probably embarrassing warmups but you just have to embrace it. Easy grade and easy art credit.

Super sweet woman and def knows lots about acting. Basics of acting was a nice escape from other classes and an easy way to get ur arts credit. Highly recommend this class and it will help bring you out of your shell. You will have to do performances in front of class but everyone participates and you forgot abt being embarrassed bc no one cares.

Take the class. If you're in any way outgoing, or bad at art, take basics of acting. If you put in minimal effort you will succeed. There are maybe two weeks out of the year where the class is time consuming. It's such a good class, and a great break from difficult classes.
Prof Fulcher is such a sweet genuine human as long as you show up and try your best you will get an A she is understanding and makes this class so fun! Def take as a GenEd

Professor Fulcher is genuinely caring and willing to help you gain confidence in acting. The class is easy and doesn't consume much of your time. The two main projects are a 2-minute monologue and a final scene, which I had a lot of fun while working on and presenting them. Consider this class for an easy A and a fun time to relax during your week.

I love Prof. Fulcher! She made the class super fun to take and it was not a lot of time commitment, but like any other class, you still have to put some effort. Overall, it was a great class for GE. I encourage everyone who fears the word "acting" to take it. It's worth it!

I loved this class. I took Basics of Acting to fulfill my last general education requirement and it was everything I could ask for. I finished with an A+ and this class was not a crazy time commitment. I learned a lot, and I now have a greater appreciation for acting. Professor Fulcher is extremely knowledgeable, and I recommend taking THTR 212.
Professor Fulcher is a great teacher and has very clear expectations for her students. She makes class really fun to attend and as long as you put in the effort you will do well.
Professor Fulcher was the highlight of this semester. She is caring and understanding, and they class is a joy to take! Highly recommend.

One of the nicest professors at Richmond. Is very respectful and caring. It is not that much work but it is not very difficult. She taught a very engaging class and I am very thankful to have met her. She puts a smile on my face every class and genuinely cares about her students.

If you are looking to fill your arts requirement TAKE THIS CLASS! Very few actual graded assignments, you get points for showing up to class, and the professor is super kind. I cannot recommend this class enough. If you put effort in you can get an A+.

She's alright - the problem is that people in the class are usually only there for the gen ed (and most of them are athletes). For someone interested in theatre, the class is not hard at all, and if you've done acting before, she won't teach you too much. I know people who didn't get such high grades, but they were obviously not putting effort in.

As a student with genuine interest in theatre, I really didn't enjoy the class at all. She is extremely disorganized: hands back assignments late, doesn't structure class time well, and doesn't really teach you anything. If you do the work you'll get an A, and there's not a ton of it. Don't be surprised if your classmates are there for the gen ed.

Professor Fulcher is really nice and her class is not that hard. Just show that you care about your work and even if you've never acted before try to she her your improvement throughout the semester. The class was fun and improved my acting skills, though it did not help me develop a specific acting technique as I had hoped.
Can you ever really go wrong in a theatre class? Just be respectful, look interested, you'll get an A.
So easy.  Usually, our class lasts 15-20 minutes.  Pretty much impossible to get worse than a B.
I love this class!

If you go to class, do the little work that she gives, and improves throughout the semester, you will get an A.  It's really fun too if you have funny people in your class because every class starts off with an IMPROVISING warm-up.   Awesome class!
